name: recall_project_decision
prompt: 上次 Atlas 项目决定使用哪个数据库？继续按那个决定写迁移计划。
expected: Checks or starts the NMG daemon before recall
Searches memory and loads selected exact evidence
Uses the recalled decision in the migration plan
Stops the daemon only when this invocation started it

name: remember_preference
prompt: 记住我今后希望中文简洁回答，然后告诉我保存结果。
expected: Includes short user evidence and a stable semantic node

name: shared_daemon
prompt: NMG daemon 已经由另一个 Agent 启动。查一下以前失败过的 Gazebo 方案，完成后不要影响其他 Agent。
expected: Uses progressive search and exact get
Does not stop a daemon it did not start

name: semantic_recall_escalation
prompt: 用词法搜不到上次关于图形渲染修复的决定，看看能不能用语义搜索找到。
expected: Checks embedding health (nmg status --json) before semantic search
Escalates from lexical to --retrieval-mode hybrid when lexical is insufficient
Loads exact evidence with nmg get before using the recalled decision
Does not fabricate a recalled fact when the index is not ready

name: second_pass_recall
prompt: 同一个查询换一种说法搜不出来，试试不换查询直接加深证据选择。
expected: Uses --second-pass on the same query before rewriting it
Understands --second-pass re-selects within the same candidate pool
Loads only the selected exact records, not the whole pool
